title: Inventory Uppercase Labels
prompt: A inventory badge list should highlight important labels. Write a function that returns a new array with every label uppercased.

explanation.beginner:
Example: inventoryUppercaseLabels(["open","Done"]) produces ["OPEN","DONE"]. Project each included record into the requested output shape, keeping the required input order.

Compare “handles empty strings”: input [[""]] produces [""]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Project each included record into the requested output shape, keeping the required input order.

Tempting mistake: A projection is different from filtering: returning a boolean from map gives booleans, while returning a value from filter only makes a keep decision.

The reference uses map. Trace the intermediate value after each operation; count repeated scans inside callbacks separately when estimating cost.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “handles empty strings”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
